description: Source code for AndroidRenameHandler class implementing rename functionality for Android resource and package renaming within an IDE plugin.

classes.name: AndroidRenameHandler
classes.description: Handles renaming of Android resources and application packages within the IDE.

methods.name: isAvailableOnDataContext
methods.description: Checks if renaming is available in the current context.

methods.name: isRenaming
methods.description: Determines if renaming can be performed in the current context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Performs the renaming operation based on context, either resource or package.

methods.name: performValueResourceRenaming
methods.description: Initiates renaming of an Android value resource.

methods.name: getActionTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the rename action.

methods.name: isPackageAttributeInManifest
methods.description: Checks if a given element is the package attribute in the Android manifest.

methods.name: performApplicationPackageRenaming
methods.description: Initiates renaming of the Android application package.
